summary_en: Kawasaki Kisen will cancel 44,429,000 shares, representing 6.95% of issued shares before cancellation, effective October 2, 2026. The cancelled shares were acquired under a buyback programme approved on May 29, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On September 25, 2026, Kawasaki Kisen's board of directors resolved to cancel 44,429,000 treasury shares, representing 6.95% of issued shares before cancellation, effective October 2, 2026. The cancelled shares were the full amount acquired under a buyback programme authorised by board resolution on May 29, 2026.

The acquisition of these 44,429,000 shares was completed on September 18, 2026, with an authorised acquisition budget of 130 billion yen. The shares were acquired through off-exchange block trades on ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between June 1 and September 30, 2026. Following cancellation, the number of outstanding shares will be 594,743,067 shares.
